! scope="row" | | 1972– | Flag of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka | A modified flag of the Dominion of Ceylon. Two fields separated by a golden : the smaller hoist-side field has only two vertical halves of green and orange and the larger fly-side field is dark red with a golden lion holding a kastane sword in its forepaw in the and a bo tree (bodhi tree) leaf on each of the four corners, and the golden around the entire flag extends in between the two separate fields. Used since the proclamation of the republic in 1972.
